title: PRESSER | Caleb Odom - Wofford Preview (11-17-26)
text: Kale, just kind of what's been the mood the past couple days or or today uh coming after that game at Oklahoma and kind of what it meant on with that loss. >> Yeah. Um it was very frustrating obviously the loss and um the way we played the mistakes that you know we see on film and we wish we could get back. Um you know obviously everybody is just kind of at a point right now where you know we can either go in our shell or we can muscle up and just finish out the season the best we can. um you know finish with nine wins is obviously the goal now and so just doing the best that we can but you know that's all we can be worried about at this point >> to that are are you seeing the locker room more lean towards going finishing this thing out as opposed to you know like you said closing into a shell >> yeah yeah for sure I think we have the guys all around this team and the uh leaders to be able to do that in each position group that you know push each and every guy in the position to you know have that have the goal be to finish strong because you know that's that's all we can do you know, >> knowing that the the playoffs are are out of the picture, I guess. Just what for you personally motivates you to to to finish strong? >> Yeah. Well, I mean, like, I think it's just the simplicity of the game. Like, I just want to come in here and just work on myself now. I know like next year is in the future and, you know, the the the games that are we still have left are in the future, but it's just coming in here and just want to be with the guys, man. Like at the end of the day, we built a brotherhood over this year and that's something that can't be broken. So, just want to come in here just keep working on myself, keep working with the guys. We ultimately still have games left to play. So, whether that's in the playoffs or not, like we still have something to fight for, something to get better at, something to look forward to in the future. So, just about coming in here, >> sort of going off that, what goals do you have for yourself as you close out the season? >> Um, goals for myself? I mean, I just I really want to continue to become a better blocker. Um, just continuing to um, you know, inc increase my technique, just, you know, being able to block um, you know, those bigger guys and stuff. But, you know, I ultimately just want to get smarter at the game, too. Um, keep watching a lot lots of film and just keep understanding football more and more as I can. Um, I think that'll ultimately help me to play faster and be a better player stuff. So, yeah. >> Wford coming up and then Mississippi State to close. Does it help having a big rivalry game at the end of the season as as something to kind of be like, you know, hey, it still matters here? >> Yeah, I think for sure. I think um I think I I think when we get to that week, you know, we're going to be super super excited obviously for that matchup. Um you know, guys like in our building like Tom Luke, they they talk to us and you know, get us ready for that game. And so that's always fun. I remember last year it was it was pretty fun. So, you know, I I think that's that's something to look forward to. Um but you know, we're just obviously focused on Watford right now, but um yeah, knowing that's in the future is something that's we definitely look forward to. >> Obviously, you guys came into the season with a lot of expectations, pressure maybe. Do you feel like that's kind of been relieved at this point and you can maybe play a little bit freer if that makes sense? >> Yeah. Uh I mean, I I I think honestly that's that's kind of the mindset we should have had this whole time. Like I don't think anybody puts any pressure on ourselves but ourselves. And so like we had to we we just needed to go into the games just playing more free and just playing faster and stuff, but at this point, you know, it ain't really nothing to lose. So I think all pressure for those guys who did have field pressure for those guys that did feel the expectations should be totally lifted off and we we just need to go out there and have fun. Just play free and just play fast. >> Do you feel like you were one of those guys or where would you kind of categorize yourself in that area? Um, I try not to let external factors really impede my mindset, but sometimes they do and sometimes, you know, things like that happen. And I would be lying if I said I didn't feel pressure or feel, you know, those expectations at some point in this year. But it's just about getting through those and just remembering the goal and the team is just to go one and0 and stuff and just have fun because football is a game at the end of the day. So appreciate
